stem: What is the main concern with inappropriate water intake in young infants?
explanation: Water intoxication and electrolyte imbalances are the main concern with inappropriate water intake in young infants.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Page 12

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because iron deficiency and worm infestation are not the risks linked to inappropriate water intake in young infants.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because inappropriate water intake in young infants can cause water intoxication and electrolyte imbalances.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because constipation and reflux are not the stated concern here.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because dental caries and obesity are not the risks described in this context.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because vitamin D toxicity is unrelated to inappropriate water intake.
